spec.title: TDS
spec.description: Displays the last known TDS value in ppm for the specific device selected within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time AS "Time",
  (metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds')::numeric AS value
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND id = '$id'
ORDER BY time DESC;

spec.title: TDS Over Time
spec.description: Displays the actual, non-aggregated time-series tracking of Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) in ppm for the selected node within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time AS "time",
  (metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds')::numeric AS "TDS"
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND id = '$id'
  AND metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time ASC;

spec.title: Temperature Value Distribution
spec.description: Displays the frequency distribution of water temperature measurements for the selected node within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT

FROM device_telemetry
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND id = '$id'
  AND metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature' IS NOT NULL;

spec.title: Temperature Over Time
spec.description: Displays the actual, non-aggregated time-series tracking of water temperature for the selected node within the active timeframe.

spec.title: Top 10 Temperature Logs
spec.description: Displays the top 10 highest water temperature measurements and their exact timestamps recorded by the selected node within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature')::numeric DESC) AS "#",
  t.time AS "Measurement Time",
  (t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature')::numeric AS "Temperature"
FROM device_telemetry t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.time)
  AND t.id = '$id'
  AND t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Temperature" DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Temperature
spec.description: Displays the last known water temperature value in Celsius for the specific device selected within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time AS "Time",
  (metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature')::numeric AS value
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND id = '$id'
ORDER BY time DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN t.time < NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS "Status",
  t.time AS "Last seen"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sub.time
  FROM device_telemetry sub
  WHERE sub.id = d.id
    AND sub.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ORDER BY sub.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON true
WHERE d.id = '$id';

WITH latest_telemetry AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    metrics,
    CASE 
      WHEN time >= NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS status_code
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE id = '$id'
    AND time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(t.status_code, 0) AS "Status",
  CASE WHEN t.status_code = 1 THEN t.metrics->'networking'->>'SSID' ELSE NULL END AS "SSID",
  CASE WHEN t.status_code = 1 THEN t.metrics->'networking'->>'local_ip' ELSE NULL END AS "Local IP"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN latest_telemetry t ON d.id = t.id
WHERE d.id = '$id';

WITH latest_telemetry AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    metrics->'telemetry'->>'firmware_version' AS firmware_version
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE id = '$id'
    AND time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  null,
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  CONCAT(d.latitude, ', ', d.longitude) AS "Coordinate",
  TO_CHAR(d.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' ' || current_setting('TIMEZONE') AS "Date Registered",
  TO_CHAR(d.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' ' || current_setting('TIMEZONE') AS "Last Updated",
  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID", 
  t.firmware_version AS "Firmware Version"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN latest_telemetry t ON d.id = t.id
WHERE d.id = '$id';

spec.title: Location
spec.description: Node location based on registered data, color represents node's status.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  d.latitude AS "latitude",
  d.longitude AS "longitude",
  d.latitude || ', ' || d.longitude AS "Coordinate",
  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID",
  d.created_at AS "Date Registered",
  d.updated_at AS "Last Updated",
  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0 
    WHEN t.time < NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 0 
    ELSE 1 
  END AS "Status",
  t.time AS "Last Seen",
  t.firmware_version AS "Firmware Version"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT id, time,
    metrics->'telemetry'->>'firmware_version' AS firmware_version
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE id = '$id'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON d.id = t.id
WHERE d.id = '$id';
